title: ReservationInput
description: Shared create and full-replacement edit request. Cross-field instant/zone semantics are validated by the service; see docs/RESERVATION_API.md.

title.description: Nonblank title, at most 120 characters; server trims leading/trailing whitespace before persistence.

time.description: Start local clock time; empty means unknown.

reference.description: User-entered booking reference; not proof of a provider booking.

status.description: User-recorded state; changing it does not transact with a provider.

location.description: Departure, check-in, pickup, or activity location.

provider.description: User-entered airline, property, operator, or booking provider.

endDate.description: End local calendar date, or empty; required for stays.

endTime.description: End local clock time, or empty when unknown.

timeZone.description: IANA zone ID for a known start clock; validated with the runtime zone database.

endTimeZone.description: IANA zone ID for a known end clock.

cancellationDeadline.description: Local cancellation deadline, or empty; minute precision without an appended zone.

cancellationTimeZone.description: IANA zone ID for a known cancellation deadline.

cancellationPolicy.description: User-recorded cancellation terms, not provider-authoritative policy.

utcOffset.description: Explicit start offset. Required for a DST overlap; must match the zone at this local time.

endUtcOffset.description: Explicit end offset, with the same zone agreement rule.

cancellationUtcOffset.description: Explicit cancellation offset, with the same zone agreement rule.
